definitions.transport_note: Each turn is one `codex exec` call (ChatGPT login, model gpt-6.1-sol) with the full conversation flattened to User:/Assistant: text and stdin closed (stdin=DEVNULL; open stdin hangs codex exec). Scoring is identical to the OpenRouter arm (same parse_response + canonicalize_answer from files/harness/run.py).
